psychology.buyerFear: Filling chairs with low-margin hygiene visits while implant and cosmetic competitors win premium cases.
psychology.desiredOutcome: More qualified implant, Invisalign, veneer, and cosmetic consults with fewer no-shows.
psychology.trustTrigger: HIPAA-aware booking, Dentrix/NexHealth integration, financing calculators, and review velocity reduce practice risk.
psychology.riskReversal: Start with a patient-value and local visibility audit before changing offers or spend.
psychology.decisionNudge: Find which procedures, reviews, and booking steps can lift case acceptance fastest.
